root_cause: Floating attention GEMV/GEMM reduction geometry differed with batch width despite F32 precision; small differences were amplified downstream in this Q8 model.
implementation: Explicit per-node AR-compatible CUDA reduction hint; grouped heads retained and token columns dispatched as parallel vector samples. No serial verification replay, and no dependence on audit/profiling phase.
